text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates.

speaker: Doctor
text: That X-ray suggests air trapping, which is often seen in obstructive lung diseases. Do you experience wheezing, particularly when you exhale, and does shortness of breath worsen during the night or upon waking?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I definitely hear a whistling sound when I breathe out, and the shortness of breath makes it hard to keep up with my work as a mechanic. The wheezing usually gets worse when I'm active or stressed, but I don't typically notice it getting significantly worse at night or when I wake up. speaker: Doctor
